# Add the thing

**Author:** @tester - 2026-01-01

## Why

Nothing does the thing yet, so nobody can tell whether it happened.

## What Changes

- **The thing happens**, once, with a record behind it.

## Follow-on changes

- **The thing happens twice**, for the collectors who asked for a second one
  the same day.
- A record anyone can read back.

deltas.text:
## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The thing is watched

The system SHALL let a reader watch the thing.

#### Scenario: alpha-SC-03 - A reader watches the thing

- **WHEN** a reader watches the thing
- **THEN** the watch is recorded

## MODIFIED Requirements

### Requirement: The thing happens once

The system SHALL do the thing exactly once, and SHALL say so.

#### Scenario: alpha-SC-01 - The thing happens

- **WHEN** a reader asks for the thing
- **THEN** the thing happens and the system says so

# The approved suite

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-02

## Why

The fixture walk needs a second change in the same lane whose suite QA has
been through, so the suite chip can be read as a verdict rather than as a
badge every change wears the same way.

## What Changes

- **The suite is signed off**, and the change waits on nothing else.

## Capabilities

- **Modified Capabilities**: demo-product/alpha

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:
## Goals

- The suite is read before the plan is built.

## Non-Goals

- Reopening the cases QA has already been through.

## Decisions

| Q | Asked | Decided | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q1 | Whether QA signs the suite off before delivery | Yes | Signing it off at the fold |

## Raised

| Capability | Raised | Landed |
| --- | --- | --- |

deltas.text:
## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The thing leaves a record

The system SHALL write one record for each thing that happens.

#### Scenario: alpha-SC-06 - The record is written
**Serves:** alpha-US-01 - Reader follows the thing end to end

- **WHEN** the thing happens
- **THEN** one record is written for it

# The Building stage

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-04

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change with one task ticked and one still open, so a
reader can tell the Building stage from Planned, and a dependency that has
not shipped yet, so the Blocked overlay has something to name.

## What Changes

- **The first task lands**, and the second waits on `demo-planned`.

## References

- [Demo Product · Discounts](../../../docs/prds/products/demo-product/index.md#discounts)

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:
## Goals

- The group ships once its tests pass, not before.

## Non-Goals

- Reopening what Planned already settled.

## Decisions

| Q | Asked | Decided | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q1 | Whether the group ships behind a flag | ❓ tester - recommended: no, ship it plain | A flag nobody flips |

## Raised

| Capability | Raised | Landed |
| --- | --- | --- |

artifacts.name: proposal
artifacts.text:
# The Designed stage

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-01

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change that has drawn both designs and gone no
further, so a reader can tell the Designed stage from the ones beside it.

## What Changes

- **Both designs land**, and nothing after them.

## References

- [Demo Product · Discounts](../../../docs/prds/products/demo-product/index.md#discounts)

## Follow-on changes

- The requirements, once somebody takes the two readings.

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:
## Goals

- Both designs are drawn from journeys already on `main`.

## Non-Goals

- The requirements - that is a later fixture's job.

# Tech design: the Designed stage

## Context

A fixture change that stops once both designs land.

## Decisions

- Nothing to decide - the fixture holds here on purpose.

artifacts.name: proposal
artifacts.text:
# One design waived, one owed

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-01

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change whose designer has written their line and
whose tech design is neither a file nor a line, so a reader can be shown
what one waiver alone leaves owed.

## What Changes

- **The UI design is waived** and the tech design is still to come.

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:
## Goals

- Both designs are answered before a requirement is written.

## Non-Goals

- Letting one line answer for the other design.

## Decisions

| Q | Asked | Decided | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q1 | Whether one waiver answers both designs | No, each design is answered on its own | One line standing for two files |

## Raised

| Capability | Raised | Landed |
| --- | --- | --- |

artifacts.name: proposal
artifacts.text:
# The On staging stage

**Author:** @tester - 2026-08-20

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change whose one task is fully checked off and
deployed to staging, and old enough that nobody has landed anything on it
for a while, so a reader can see the Idle overlay beside a stage other than
Building.

## What Changes

- **The only task lands**, and the deploy is recorded.

artifacts.name: rounds
artifacts.text:
# Rounds

One row per round: what it read, who read it, what stood and what it asked.
Written by the landing, in the landing's own commit.

| Round | Artifact | Perspectives | Stood | Asked | Tests |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | tasks | the-simpler-thing; nitpick | nothing stood | - | - |
| 2 | 1 | missing-pieces; code-smell | the fixture's one task lands cleanly | Q1 | alpha-SC-01: test/thing.test.ts |
| 3 | proposal | the-simpler-thing | the why holds without the extra paragraph | - | - |

# The overlay set

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-02

## Why

The fixture walk needs one change wearing all five overlays at once, so a
reader can be shown the closed set and nothing outside it.

## What Changes

- **Nothing of its own** - the change exists so the five chips have one card
  to sit on.

## Capabilities

- **Modified Capabilities**: demo-product/alpha

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:

- Every overlay has a card to sit on.

## Non-Goals

- Moving the stage - no overlay does.

## Decisions

| Q | Asked | Decided | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q1 | Whether an overlay may move the stage | No | Letting a chip stand for a rung |

## Raised

| Capability | Raised | Landed |
| --- | --- | --- |

# The Planned stage

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-03

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change with a plan and nothing ticked yet, so a
reader can tell the Planned stage from Building.

## What Changes

- **A plan lands**, claimed by nobody, with nothing checked off.

## Follow-on changes

- The proposal moved after `decisions.md` was reviewed, which is what the
  Behind overlay on this fixture shows.

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:
## Goals

- The plan exists before anything is checked off.

## Non-Goals

- Building the thing - that is a later fixture's job.

## Decisions

| Q | Asked | Decided | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q1 | Whether to plan before building | Yes | Building without a plan |

## Raised

| Capability | Raised | Landed |
| --- | --- | --- |

artifacts.name: proposal
artifacts.text:
# Shorten the refund window

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-06

## Why

The walk needs a Planned-stage change linking one page section on its own,
so the pip it carries never moves what another fixture's Behind chip reads.

## What Changes

- **The refund window shortens**, once the plan is read.

## References

- [Demo Product · Refunds](../../../docs/prds/products/demo-product/index.md#refunds)

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:
## Goals

- The refund window is shorter, and the page says so on its marked line.

## Non-Goals

- The designs and the requirements - the fixture is about the page's in-flight row and its pip.

## Decisions

| Q | Asked | Decided | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q1 | How short the window becomes | Fourteen days | Thirty days |

## Raised

| Capability | Raised | Landed |
| --- | --- | --- |

artifacts.name: proposal
artifacts.text:
# The Released stage

**Author:** @tester - 2026-08-01

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change that has shipped, so a reader can tell the
Released stage from On staging - and one whose artifacts landed on known
days, so the handoff has days to show.

## What Changes

- **The only task lands**, deployed and released.

## Capabilities

- **Modified Capabilities**: demo-product/alpha

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:
## Goals

- The change ships, and the days it took are readable after it has.

## Non-Goals

- Reopening anything the release closed.

## Decisions

| Q | Asked | Decided | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q1 | Whether a shipped change keeps its handoff | Yes | Dropping the days at the cut |

## Raised

| Capability | Raised | Landed |
| --- | --- | --- |

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-02

The fixture walk needs a change whose requirements are written and whose
suite is still a draft, so a reader can tell the Specified stage apart from
Planned.

## What Changes

- **A requirement lands**, with a scenario the suite can trace.

## Capabilities

- **Modified Capabilities**: demo-product/alpha

artifacts.name: decisions

# An unreadable record

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-06

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change whose `.openspec.yaml` nobody could read, so
a reader can see how the board shows a record nothing could parse.

## What Changes

- **Nothing** - the record itself is broken.

artifacts.name: proposal
artifacts.text:
# The Waiting overlay

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-05

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change that names what it is waiting on, so a
reader can see the Waiting overlay beside a change still Proposed.

## What Changes

- **Nothing yet** - the designer has not drawn the frame.

artifacts.name: proposal
artifacts.text:
# The waived design

**Author:** @tester - 2026-09-01

## Why

The fixture walk needs a change that says in one line that it draws
nothing, with the other design written, so a reader can be shown a waiver
standing for the file it names.

## What Changes

- **One design is waived** and the other lands, which is all Designed asks
  for.

artifacts.name: decisions
artifacts.text:
## Goals

- The ladder moves on a line where there is nothing to draw.

## Non-Goals

- Drawing a screen nobody asked for.

## Decisions

| Q | Asked | Decided | Instead of |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Q1 | Whether a waiver needs a reason | Yes, one line of it | A bare flag |

## Raised

| Capability | Raised | Landed |
| --- | --- | --- |

artifacts.name: tech-design
artifacts.text:
# Tech design

## Decisions

- **One writer** - the thing is counted where it happens, not in a second
  job that reads the log after.

## Risks

- **Nothing to draw** is a claim the designer makes, not an oversight the
  ladder should wait on.
